title: OpenAI Says July Annualized Revenue Topped All of Q2
excerpt: OpenAI told staff July revenue beat all of Q2, landing as Microsoft and Meta defended heavy AI capital spending.
content_html:
OpenAI told employees that annualized recurring revenue (ARR) in July surpassed the company's entire second quarter, according to a partial internal transcript reviewed by CNBC.

Chief Financial Officer Sarah Friar shared the figure on Wednesday alongside board chair Bret Taylor.

OpenAI Says July Annualized Revenue Outpaced the Entire Second Quarter

Friar and Taylor credited the GPT-5.6 model series, enterprise agent ChatGPT Work, and the rising adoption of the Codex coding tool.

"And Q2 was no slouch," she said.

Speaking to employees, Taylor said Anthropic entered the year with strong momentum. He conceded that OpenAI had been playing catch-up in coding but noted that Codex's expansion has been encouraging.

"You're seeing people who went deep on Claude Code, ended up with a very high bill, and started looking for an alternative," Taylor stated.

The report did not disclose any absolute revenue figure. Nonetheless, earlier disclosures give some sense of the firm's revenue scale. 

The Information highlighted that OpenAI's annualized revenue topped $25 billion at the end of February, citing a person familiar with the figure.

The same outlet reported in June that OpenAI burned $3.7 billion in the first quarter, against $5.7 billion in revenue. 

Now, the latest internal message follows April reporting that OpenAI missed internal revenue and weekly active user targets. 

Follow us on X to get the latest news as it happens

Microsoft, Meta, Alphabet, and Amazon Report Quarterly Results 

Meanwhile, OpenAI's reported revenue growth arrives as several of the largest AI spenders publish quarterly results.

Microsoft closed its fiscal fourth quarter on June 30 with revenue of $90.0 billion, up 18%. Operating income also climbed 18% to $40.6 billion.

Meta reported revenue of $60.80 billion, beating the roughly $59.50 billion analysts expected, up 28% from a year earlier.

Alphabet reported last week $119.8 billion in second-quarter revenue, up 24%. Apple and Amazon publish results on Thursday.

OpenAI is not a public company, so it is not required to disclose quarterly figures. The company closed a record $122 billion round in March at a post-money valuation of $852 billion.

The firm has submitted a confidential S-1 registration statement to the SEC in June. That filing was its first formal step toward an initial public offering (IPO).

content_html_zh:
根据 CNBC 审阅的部分内部记录，OpenAI 告诉员工，7 月份的年化经常性收入 (ARR) 超过了公司整个第二季度的收入。

周三，首席财务官莎拉·弗里尔 (Sarah Friar) 与董事会主席布雷特·泰勒 (Bret Taylor) 分享了这一数字。

OpenAI 称 7 月份年化收入超过整个第二季度

Friar 和 Taylor 归功于 GPT-5.6 模型系列、企业代理 ChatGPT Work 以及 Codex 编码工具的日益普及。

“第二季度也毫不逊色，”她说。

泰勒对员工表示，Anthropic 以强劲的势头进入了这一年。 他承认 OpenAI 在编码方面一直在追赶，但指出 Codex 的扩张令人鼓舞。

“你会看到人们深入研究克劳德代码，最终得到了非常高的账单，并开始寻找替代方案，”泰勒说。

该报告没有透露任何绝对收入数字。 尽管如此，早期披露的信息还是可以让我们了解该公司的收入规模。

The Information 援引一位知情人士的话说，截至 2 月底，OpenAI 的年化收入突破了 250 亿美元。

同一家媒体 6 月份报道称，OpenAI 第一季度烧钱 37 亿美元，而营收为 57 亿美元。

现在，最新的内部消息是在 4 月份报道 OpenAI 未达到内部收入和每周活跃用户目标之后发布的。

在 X 上关注我们以获取最新消息

微软、Meta、Alphabet 和亚马逊公布季度业绩

与此同时，OpenAI 报告的收入增长随着几家最大的人工智能支出者发布季度业绩而到来。

微软于 6 月 30 日结束第四财季，营收达 900 亿美元，增长 18%。 营业收入也增长了 18%，达到 406 亿美元。

Meta 公布的营收为 608 亿美元，超出分析师预期的约 595 亿美元，同比增长 28%。

Alphabet 上周公布第二季度营收 1198 亿美元，增长 24%。 苹果和亚马逊周四公布业绩。

OpenAI 不是一家上市公司，因此不需要披露季度数据。 该公司 3 月份完成了创纪录的 1,220 亿美元融资，投后估值为 8,520 亿美元。

该公司已于 6 月向 SEC 提交了一份保密的 S-1 注册声明。 该文件是其迈向首次公开募股（IPO）的正式第一步。
